title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: The People of the State of New York, represented in Senate and Assembly, do enact as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: (d) "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" ... means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person shall sell or offer for sale ... anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

date.provenance: This act shall take effect immediately.

who.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes ...; certificate of compliance shall be signed by an authorized official of the manufacturer.

action.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes ...

products.provenance: no person shall sell or offer for sale ... anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

value: if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer that the product met the requirements of this section
exceptions.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.
